=== Starting [Task Name] ===

Translation Task: Translate 'The sky is blue.' to French, then back to English, repeat 10 times. Output 'FR:' and 'EN:' labeled lines.

Permutation Task: List every permutation of the letters ABCD exactly once, separated by spaces.

==================================================
